title: Sabbin salo daga toshe ɗaya: bangarori, hannayen riga da kwala

say: Sabbin salo daga toshe ɗaya: bangarori, hannayen riga da kwala.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na uku na Advanced Tailoring and Pattern Yin.
Gyaran tsari yana nufin canza shingen da aka gwada akan takarda don yin sabon salo. Saboda toshe ya riga ya dace, kowane sabon salo yana kiyaye wannan dacewa a wuyansa, kafada, bust da kugu.

Gaskiya kowane sabon dinki

say: Koyaushe yi aiki akan kwafi, ba maigida ba, tare da layin hatsi, bust point da alamar ƙira.

say: Kowane kwala yana farawa daga tsayin wuyan wuyan da aka auna akan ƙirar. Don tsayawar mandarin, zana rectangle rabin layin wuyan tsayi. Ɗaga ƙarshen gaban ƙananan gefen ta 1 zuwa 1.5 cm, don haka ya rungume wuyansa.

panel.heading: Abun wuya uku daga layin wuya

cards.d: Rectangle, rabin layin wuya. Ɗaga ƙarshen gaba 1 zuwa 1.5 cm don haka ya rungume wuyansa.
Haɗa kafadu 1 zuwa 2 cm a ƙarshen hannun hannu. Wannan yana ba da ɗan birgima wanda ke ɓoye kabu.
Tsaya masu lankwasa zuwa sama; ƙwala masu lanƙwasa ƙasa a gaba. Collar 1 zuwa 1.5 cm zurfi a baya.

say: Don tunawa. Yi aiki akan kwafin tubalan ku. Ƙarfin da aka rufe zai iya zama karkiya, taruwa ko walƙiya. Raba daidaitattun canje-canje a cikin duk kabu.
Zazzage hannun riga daga ramin hannu, da ƙulla daga layin wuyan da aka auna.

say: Yanzu yi salo guda uku daga toshe ɗaya, daftarin kuma gaskiya na gimbiya bodice, gwada saitin hannun riga a calico, sannan ku yi samfurin abin wuyanku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
